description: Synchronize documentation across multiple files and validate cross-references

context.task_description: Synchronize documentation content and validate cross-references between files
requirements: Identify documentation inconsistencies across specified files
Update target documentation to match source content
Validate all cross-references and internal links
Ensure consistent formatting and style across documents
Generate report of changes made and validation results
constraints: Must preserve original document structure and formatting
Cross-reference updates must maintain link integrity
Changes must be backward compatible with existing references
All modifications must be clearly documented and traceable

sync_operations.content_analysis: Compare source and target content for inconsistencies
sync_operations.cross_reference_validation: Verify all internal and external links
